svg.data-vd-play-label: Play: shoot bends to the light
svg.data-vd-steps: [[0, "A shoot lit from one side only."], [1, "Auxin made in the tip moves to the shaded side."], [3.5, "Auxin moves down the shaded side of the shoot."], [6, "Cells on the shaded side elongate more than cells on the lit side."], [8, "Unequal growth bends the shoot towards the light: positive phototropism."]]
svg.title: Phototropism
svg.desc: A shoot lit from one side: auxin from the tip moves to the shaded side, cells there elongate more and the shoot bends towards the light; a magnified view compares cells on the two sides.
svg.text: Phototropism: auxin and bending towards light
Orange dots: auxin. Light comes from the right only.

g.data-info: Unidirectional light. The shoot bends towards it: positive phototropism, which helps the leaves absorb more light for photosynthesis.
More auxin, so cells elongate more.
Less auxin, so cells elongate less.
Moves away from the light to the shaded side, then down the shoot. It makes cell walls loosen so cells elongate.
